definition: Classless Inter-Domain Routing notation specifying an IP address range. For VPCs, the primary CIDR must be between /16 and /28.
An isolated location within an AWS Region with independent power, cooling, and networking. Subnets are AZ-scoped.
A subnet with a route table entry directing 0.0.0.0/0 traffic to an Internet Gateway, enabling internet-facing resources.
A subnet without a direct route to an Internet Gateway. Resources access the internet only via a NAT Gateway.
The principle that resources in separate VPCs cannot communicate by default, providing a security boundary.
The process of mapping private IP addresses to public IP addresses for internet communication.
Route evaluation method where the most specific route matching the destination IP is selected.
A firewall tracking connection state — return traffic is automatically allowed if the initial request was permitted.
A firewall evaluating each packet independently — inbound and outbound rules must be configured separately.
Routing where traffic can pass through intermediate nodes. Transit Gateway supports this; VPC peering does not.
Protocol suite for encrypting and authenticating IP packets, used by AWS Site-to-Site VPN connections.
Network topology where all nodes connect to a central hub rather than directly to each other. Transit Gateway pattern.
Network addressing where the same IP is announced from multiple locations. Used by Global Accelerator.
A CloudFront data center caching content closer to end users, reducing latency for global audiences.
Examining the data payload of network packets (not just headers) for security threats. AWS Network Firewall capability.
Security approach using fine-grained policies (e.g., per-workload security groups) instead of broad network zones.
Layered security approach using multiple controls (security groups + NACLs + Network Firewall) at different levels.
A static public IPv4 address that persists across instance stop/start cycles. Required for NAT Gateways.
A virtual network card attached to an instance. Security groups and PrivateLink endpoints operate at ENI level.
A logical interface on a Direct Connect connection. Private VIF for VPC access, Public VIF for AWS public services.
